card.name: Dark Petition
card.oracle_text:
Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle.
Spell mastery — If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, add {B}{B}{B}.

abilities.note: Spell mastery (2+ instants/sorceries in graveyard) adds {B}{B}{B} on resolution. NOT modelled: the sim ignores `condition`, so an add_mana here would give BBB unconditionally (a fabrication).
